composition_subtypes.role: Sort exams by official date a_i
Greedily choose b_i if >= last day, else a_i

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort by a_i, then greedily pick b_i if feasible, else a_i, to minimize final day.
payload.rationale: The solution combines sorting to order exams by a_i and a greedy pass that maintains the smallest possible last day.
